decision.rationale: User approved the Old L5 agent retirement wave plan. Covered core edits migrate active references away from already-authorized deprecated L5 shims to existing canonical utility modules; they do not add a new core mechanism, layer, contract, or app capability.

spine_substrate_test.evidence: Replacement targets are existing L5 safety utilities, not new spine substrate.

any_app_capability_test.evidence: No app capability is added to core; Old L5 shim retirement removes technical debt.

app_owned_meaning_test.evidence: No app-owned semantics are introduced or moved into core.

no_app_literal_test.evidence: Covered paths are L5 safety/governance references only.

plugin_test.evidence: No plugin behavior is added or modified.

negative_control_test.evidence: W4 physical deletion remains blocked until cooling-window eligibility or explicit override.

boundary_preservation_test.evidence: Changes preserve L5 safety ownership and route callers from deprecated shims to canonical utilities.

contract_compatibility_test.evidence: Focused tests and seam import checks are required by W5 before closeout.

runtime_proof_compatibility_test.evidence: No runtime proof mode is introduced; W1 only updates import/reference surfaces.
